data.narrative:
Mission Zero Technologies is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Nicholas Chadwick, Shiladitya Ghosh, and Gaël Gobaille-Shaw. The target operates within a competitive landscape of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though no direct same-stage or adjacent-stage peers provided sufficient data for reliable median-based valuation.

Stage-progression analysis, the only applicable triangulation method, uses the company's $22M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage transitions, yielding $44M. This method is grounded in observed step-up patterns across similar-stage companies in the sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $37M to $50M, with a median of $44M. The range reflects uncertainty inherent in a single-method triangulation and the absence of narrowly comparable Series A peers in Climate & Energy at similar valuation tiers. Key sensitivities include actual capital deployment trajectory post-Series A and the timing and magnitude of technical or commercial inflection points, neither of which are quantifiable from available data. Investors should treat the range as illustrative of early-stage positioning rather than a precise valuation anchor.
